notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental figures from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); beginning/ending cash = total fund balances (all cash/CDs/investments; due from/to other funds net to zero in the total). Taxes 58,776 split from the General Fund (p10) and Street Fund (p13) schedules; the Statement of Activities (p2) property taxes 44,903 = general levy + property tax credits + township taxes, other taxes 13,873 = motor vehicle + NPPD. Intergovernmental - state 111,035 split from the same schedules. Statement 'Other' 31,715 kept as one line (Rentals dominant). Business-type: proprietary statement totals column (p6); no single total printed, receipts/disbursements totals computed. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p3, totals equal government-wide p1) plus proprietary lines (p5); totals from p1. Detail: individual fund schedules (pp10-21); the combined all-funds budget-and-actual schedule (p9) is not recorded because it combines all funds (including utilities) into one column and the fund schedules are more detailed; utility funds have no schedule of their own. Read pages 1-21 of 21
